cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've held my envelopes up to the light like you. Addresses verified. The birthday invitations failed somewhere in mailing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was checking whether the cheque was inside. You wrote our old address on every one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Contents checked. The archive supplied an outdated location.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then address verification needs another checker. Read the new list to dispatch; we'll rewrite the envelopes.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies the practical error and B4 rejects impersonal blame; A5 asks B for useful help with corrected envelopes.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's identification to add another checker while continuing to speak of dispatch, rather than admit the personal role.
